reach_sensitivity.interpretation: Nine deterministic reach cases, not probabilities or confidence intervals. CAL and BRINE service reach each vary independently by -25%, 0%, +25%. Budget, prices, effects, baseline and coverage ceilings stay fixed. Equipment and whole cells are re-optimized in each case. Retention is measured baseline assigned road length that remains assigned, regardless of package. No unrounded optimality claim is made.

interpretation: Illustrative service reach, not measured fleet capacity. Whole cells use conservative 10 m capacity accounting. Budget portfolios are enumerated exactly over these conservative project profiles. Saved-input SciPy benchmarks optimize the unrounded primary objective only. No dispatch, concurrent storm, staffing, travel-time, safety or hydrologic model is implied.
